note: Eight interleaved pairs on one host, alternating which runtime ran first. The same null broker served both. The parent stores FetchedRecord.topic as a String, one heap allocation per record. The candidate stores names of at most 23 bytes inline. Every run verified 20,000 records and validation_failures stayed 0. Allocation count fell from 135,629 to 629. Before median 509,804.85 records/s, after median 590,935.33. Paired mean ratio 1.215, bootstrap 95% CI 1.129 to 1.315. Zero of eight pairs were slower. Client CPU-nanoseconds per record medians were 1,881.60 before and 1,622.03 after (mean ratio 0.820). Not a fetch comparison against other clients and not a fastest-client result.
host: Intel Xeon, 4 logical cores at 2400 MHz, Linux 6.12.94+, rustc 1.99.0, release
